Create solution legend

Source: R/method_Legend.R
create_solution_legend.Rd

Create a legend for solutions generated with the tool.

Usage

create_solution_legend(
  project,
  zone_colors = get_golem_config("zone_colors"),
  zone_locked_colors = get_golem_config("zone_locked_colors")
)

Arguments

project

new_project() object.

zone_colors

character vector of colors for each zone. Defaults to get_golem_config("zone_colors").

zone_locked_colors

character vector of colors for each zone. Defaults to get_golem_config("zone_locked_colors").

Value

A new_categorical_legend() object.

Details

Note that colors for zones are specified in the golem configuration file.

See also

Other functions for calling class methods: create_dataset_from_sf(), create_legend(), create_solution(), create_solution_from_prioritization(), create_tile_from_file(), create_tile_from_project(), create_tile_from_sf(), new_dataset(), tool_generated_provenance()

Examples

# simulate project
p <- simulate_project()

# create solution legend
x <- create_solution_legend(p)

# print legend
print(x)
#> $values
#> [1] 1 2 3 4 5 6
#> 
#> $colors
#> [1] "#C0FFBF" "#DEEBFF" "#FEEDF5" "#4daf4a" "#377eb8" "#f781bf"
#> 
#> $labels
#> [1] "Biodiversity locked"   "Tourism locked"        "Scientific locked"    
#> [4] "Biodiversity priority" "Tourism priority"      "Scientific priority"  
#> 
#> attr(,"class")
#> [1] "SolutionLegend" "Legend"
